purpose: Clear position in paragraph one, required by BUSEPT Writing Task 1/2.

phrases.text: This essay will argue that __ because __.

purpose: Support each body paragraph with a concrete example, as BUSEPT graders reward specificity.

phrases.text: For instance, a recent study showed that __.
A clear example of this is __.

Statistics indicate that __, which supports this point.

purpose: Develop the counter-argument in Task 2 contrast structures.

purpose: Required structures for cause/effect essays and Reading II matching passages.

phrases.text: One major cause of this is __.

purpose: Finish with a clear summary and final position, expected in both writing tasks.

phrases.text: In conclusion, the evidence clearly supports the view that __.

Overall, it seems that __ will continue to grow in importance.
